note: Schemas are versioned wire formats, not permission grants or MLCraft action capabilities. Conditional fields retain their original switch/option definitions.

packets.name: teleport_confirm
packets.purpose: Maintenance: acknowledge server teleport; not a teleport ability.

packets.name: query_block_nbt
packets.purpose: Restricted: debug block-NBT query.

packets.name: set_difficulty
packets.purpose: Restricted: request difficulty change where permitted.

packets.name: chat
packets.purpose: Submit chat or slash command; command permissions apply.

packets.name: client_command
packets.purpose: Request respawn or updated statistics.

packets.name: settings
packets.purpose: Send client preferences, not world rules.

packets.name: tab_complete
packets.purpose: Request text/command completions.

packets.name: enchant_item
packets.purpose: Select current menu button; also used outside enchanting.

packets.name: window_click
packets.purpose: Inventory/menu click, revision and predicted changes.

packets.name: close_window
packets.purpose: Close current inventory/container menu.

packets.name: custom_payload
packets.purpose: Client-brand/plugin/mod payload; channel-defined behavior.

packets.name: edit_book
packets.purpose: Edit book; optional title signs it. Legacy hand field means inventory slot in this version.

packets.name: query_entity_nbt
packets.purpose: Restricted: debug entity-NBT query.

packets.name: use_entity
packets.purpose: Interact, attack, or interact at entity-local point.

packets.name: generate_structure
packets.purpose: Restricted: request jigsaw structure generation.

packets.name: keep_alive
packets.purpose: Maintenance: heartbeat reply.

packets.name: lock_difficulty
packets.purpose: Restricted: request difficulty lock where permitted.

packets.name: position
packets.purpose: Report control/physics-generated position; server validates.

packets.name: position_look
packets.purpose: Report position and camera together; server validates.

packets.name: look
packets.purpose: Report camera orientation in protocol degrees.

packets.name: flying
packets.purpose: Report on-ground state; packet name does not grant flight.

packets.name: vehicle_move
packets.purpose: Report controlled vehicle position/orientation.

packets.name: steer_boat
packets.purpose: Report boat paddle input.

packets.name: pick_item
packets.purpose: Move existing inventory item to selected hotbar slot.

packets.name: craft_recipe_request
packets.purpose: Request recipe placement in current crafting menu.

packets.name: abilities
packets.purpose: Toggle flying only if server has granted permission.

packets.name: block_dig
packets.purpose: Mine start/cancel/finish, drop stack/item, release use, swap hands.

packets.name: entity_action
packets.purpose: Sneak/sprint, leave bed, horse jump/inventory, elytra start.

packets.name: steer_vehicle
packets.purpose: Vehicle directional input and jump/dismount flags.

packets.name: pong
packets.purpose: Maintenance: reply to server ping.

packets.name: recipe_book
packets.purpose: Set recipe-book open/filter preferences.

packets.name: displayed_recipe
packets.purpose: Acknowledge displayed recipe.

packets.name: name_item
packets.purpose: Change anvil naming text.

packets.name: resource_pack_receive
packets.purpose: Report resource-pack acceptance/download outcome.

packets.name: advancement_tab
packets.purpose: Select advancement tab or report screen close.

packets.name: select_trade
packets.purpose: Select displayed trade offer.

packets.name: set_beacon_effect
packets.purpose: Choose beacon powers; payment/level restrictions apply.

packets.name: held_item_slot
packets.purpose: Select hotbar slot 0–8.

packets.name: update_command_block
packets.purpose: Restricted: edit command block.

packets.name: update_command_block_minecart
packets.purpose: Restricted: edit command-block minecart.

packets.name: set_creative_slot
packets.purpose: Creative: set/delete stack or drop via special slot.

packets.name: update_jigsaw_block
packets.purpose: Restricted: edit jigsaw configuration.

packets.name: update_structure_block
packets.purpose: Restricted: configure/save/load structure block.

packets.name: update_sign
packets.purpose: Submit four sign lines through valid editor context.

packets.name: arm_animation
packets.purpose: Swing hand; damage/mining is separate.

packets.name: spectate
packets.purpose: Spectator: request camera/teleport target UUID.

packets.name: block_place
packets.purpose: Use item on block hit point; may place or interact.

packets.name: use_item
packets.purpose: Use held item in air with selected hand.
